app.subtitle: WARCRAFT II SCENARIO BUILDER
search.emptyHint: Search includes names, groups, parameters and text. Try another query or clear it.
catalog.title: Catalogue
scenario.title: Scenario
scenario.orderNote: Grouping and sorting affect presentation only. The execution order in the game stays unchanged.
scenario.emptyBody: Choose a condition and an action. For example: Blue has no units → victory.
rule.title: Trigger
rule.automatic: The editor allocates the necessary internal values and switches automatically.
condition.alwaysHint: Actions run on every trigger-program pass. Use a condition for actions that should not repeat continuously.
builder.emptyBody: Select a catalogue element or an existing trigger. Its parameters appear here immediately.
builder.preload: This setting is needed before the mission starts. It will be inserted at the beginning of the program.
builder.fileNote: The file changes only when you click Save.
builder.help: The catalogue on the left has groups and alphabetical sorting. Your scenario is in the centre; configure it on the right. Choose an element, fill in its parameters and add the completed trigger. To win, choose a condition and the Victory action. Mission objective — custom text changes the displayed assignment only. Global search includes the catalogue and current scenario. View sorting never changes execution order. Saving creates a backup.
field.noParameters: This action has no additional parameters.
flag.help: A switch remembers yes or no, such as ‘reward already granted’. It does not define victory by itself. In the regular builder, numbers are allocated automatically.
description.7: Read the chosen parameter for the selected players. The original Flags number for additional players is replaced by named choices.
flag.exampleSet: After granting a reward, add ‘Switch: set value’ and turn switch 7 on.
flag.exampleCheck: In another trigger, choose Switch, number 7 and On — yes. Its actions will run after the reward is granted.
flag.sameNumber: The same number connects the setter and the check. The number itself is neither a quantity nor the yes/no state.
description.21: A flag, or switch, stores yes/no. Choose its number and new state; a condition with the same number can check it.
welcome.title: A condition. An action. Your story.
welcome.body: Build scenarios with clear blocks: choose when a trigger runs and what happens. Open a map or start a new scenario.
notice.opened: Scenario opened. Select an element to configure it.
notice.applied: Changes added to the scenario. Remember to save the file.
recovery.empty: There are no recovery snapshots yet.
group.description.values: Manual variable operations for advanced scenarios.
group.description.mission: The assignment for the player and mission outcome.
group.description.world: Change the world and game rules.
description.120: Describe the assignment in your own words. Define victory conditions with a separate trigger.
description.2: Select a standard game objective by its number.
description.24: End the mission in victory when the selected condition is met.
description.25: End the mission in defeat when the selected condition is met.
description.37: Display a message for a specified duration.
error.rule.no_free_registers: No safe scratch slots are available: every free number already appears in the program. Use a separate scenario or advanced mode.
error.rule.invalid_action: This command cannot be placed inside a regular trigger. Add it as a separate setting.
error.rule.unsafe_replacement: This block cannot be safely replaced by the builder. Its original commands have been preserved.
error.rule.unknown_condition: The builder does not support this condition yet.
